text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the academy's permission, 
we set off on a two-day field trip 
to Yukino Bijin's hometown.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, if I recall... you said there 
was 
a "horsegirl you wanted us to meet" in 
your hometown, right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! There's a famous horsegirl lady 
livin' in the village next to ours.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...After climbin' the sacred mountain the 
other day, 
I remembered somethin'.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Horsegirls runnin' in races aren't the 
only ones 
who can "turn human dreams into power."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And the human dreams a horsegirl carries 
come in all sorts of shapes and sizes, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
In fact, the big sis horsegirl who's 
carried 
human dreams ever since I was a little kid 
was just like that.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanted so bad for all of us 
to go and meet that big sis.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Since we'll be carryin' human dreams 
through our Program 
at the Goshiki Shuntaisai, too.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Yuki-chaaan! 
Over here, over here!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Mifuyu-chan! 
—Ah, I gotta introduce ya to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
This is Mifuyu-chan. 
She's my childhood friend!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~, so nice♪ 
Yukino has a human childhood friend!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Yup! And as for that "big sis" from the 
neighboring 
village you all wanted to meet~...? 
—...She's actually right here!

text_block_list.name: Ultra-Buff Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Ohooo! 
Welcome, Yukino! Mifuyu!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wh-Whaaat...?!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
She's waaaay more jacked than Boo is, 
whoaaa?!
choice_data_list: You're in incredible shape, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's exceedingly rare to encounter a 
horsegirl 
with shoulders this broad and sturdy. 
...Her calves are remarkably 
well-developed, too.

text_block_list.name: Ultra-Buff Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Aahaha! A farmer's body is their greatest 
asset, after all!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Sure is! Big Sis graduated from 
agricultural college 
and became a professional farmer! 
Her strength is downright unbelievable!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Big Sis! Would ya mind showin' everyone 
your Oohiki Mikoshi, too?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Huuuuh?!?! What's with this insane size?!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis's custom mikoshi is a whole size 
bigger 
than Yukino's, whoaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Ultra-Buff Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's not just for looks, ya know. 
Go on, girls. —Give it a pull!

text_block_list.name: Yukino & Mayano
text_block_list.text:
"E-Eeeek~~..." 
"No waaaay! It's too heaavyyy!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, every horsegirl who challenged Big 
Sis's mikoshi 
fell before it, despite their valiant 
efforts...
choice_data_list:
Both the size and the weight are totally 
monstrous...

text_block_list.name: Ultra-Buff Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
The Oohiki Mikoshi festival originally 
started from the tradition 
of hauling harvested vegetables on a 
shrine float, right?

text_block_list.name: Ultra-Buff Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
"Carry the joy, carry the harvest." 
"Share in life's blessed fortune." 
That's what this festival is all about.

text_block_list.name: Ultra-Buff Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
So if you can haul a huuuuge mikoshi, 
doesn't it feel like you can share that 
much more good fortune?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *pant*... 
That logic... makes sense, but...

text_block_list.name: Ultra-Buff Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! It's not like I could pull this 
monster 
right from the start, either. 
It's just that...

text_block_list.name: Villagers
text_block_list.text:
"Look at you, pulling such a huge 
mikoshi!" 
"Well color me impressed...!" 
"You just might become the best hauler 
this village has ever seen~"

text_block_list.name: Young Buff Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
...Ghhh, I will, I will! 
I know I can do it!

text_block_list.name: Young Buff Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Master Craftsman Grandpa~~! 
Make my mikoshi even bigger, pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Master Craftsman Grandpa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there! Any bigger than this, 
and it'll outsize the one your mother used 
to pull!

text_block_list.name: Master Craftsman Grandpa
text_block_list.text:
Haha... I always dreamed of the day 
someone 
would surpass that one, but... 
Well I'll be, it's gonna be her own 
daughter who does it...!

text_block_list.name: Ultra-Buff Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
...And one thing led to another, until 
eventually 
my mikoshi ended up bigger than my mom's.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...—! 
Hey. Big Sis's story sounds just like—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's just like the legend on that stone 
monument! 
She grew "stronger by carrying human 
dreams"!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, she has carried the dreams of 
humans 
since her youth, and they have watched her 
grow.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
So Big Sis received even bigger dreams 
from everyone, right?! 
Because they believed she could do even 
more...!

text_block_list.name: Ultra-Buff Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha. Hey now, what brought this on all 
of a sudden? 
You're gonna make me blush if you lay it 
on that thick!

text_block_list.name: Super Muscular Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Well, we finished practice and worked up a 
good sweat. Time to eat, eat! 
You folks are gonna join us for dinner at 
my place, right?

text_block_list.name: Super Muscular Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
C'mon now, eat up, eat up! 
There's plenty of seconds where that came 
from!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa~~?! The savory flavor, the perfect 
saltiness! 
And these carrots and leafy greens are to 
die for!

text_block_list.name: Super Muscular Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh, all thanks to the Oobiki Mikoshi. 
Pull off the Great Haul, and the bountiful 
harvests keep comin'. 
And if the harvests keep comin'—

text_block_list.name: Villager A
text_block_list.text:
Hello there~. 
Brought over some simmered taro to share 
today~.

text_block_list.name: Super Muscular Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Ume-chan! 
Here, take some fresh-picked carrots from 
our place 
home with ya as a thank-you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, to share?! 
Does that mean all these side dishes on 
the table are...?

text_block_list.name: Super Muscular Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Yup. Most of it's shared food. 
Ume-chan and the others had a bumper crop 
too, after all.

text_block_list.name: Super Muscular Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
When a nutritious spread like this lines 
the table, 
my muscles get bigger and stronger.

text_block_list.name: Super Muscular Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
And the bigger my muscles get, 
the bigger the Oobiki Mikoshi I can haul! 
Aha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... That's so nice. 
Big Sis and the villagers, it's just like 
a team.

text_block_list.name: Super Muscular Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Catch ya later, then! 
Yukino, you folks'll be back tomorrow, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes'm! If I recall, tomorrow's... 
your costume fitting, right, Big Sis?

text_block_list.name: Super Muscular Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Bullseye. 
For the Oobiki Mikoshi, the attire and the 
bells are vital.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Jingle, jingle...♪)

text_block_list.name: Super Muscular Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
...Heheheh. 
This is the bell I received last year.

text_block_list.name: Super Muscular Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
You might know already, but for the Great 
Haul, 
each puller horsegirl receives just one 
bell 
from a person per festival.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That right there is the "Puller's Bell"!

text_block_list.name: Super Muscular Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, wishing for the haul to go safely 
without a hitch. 
You're preparing Puller's Bells for the 
Goshiki Shuntaisai too, right?
choice_data_list:
Yes, we plan to have them ready before the 
event—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, I felt as if 
my eyes met Yukino Bijin's childhood 
friend's.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... Truly magnificent! 
Both the sheer size of the mikoshi and Big 
Sis's physique!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The more human dreams a horsegirl 
shoulders, 
the greater the strength she gains... 
Big Sis is living proof of that.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Plus! When there's a horsegirl who can 
live up to 
those dreams so brilliantly, humans can't 
help 
wanting to entrust even more to her!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'm so glad you get it! 
That's what's so amazin' about Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...I wanna become like Big Sis too. 
A horsegirl who can shoulder everyone's 
dreams 
and truly live up to 'em.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While the Shinkoma were bustling with 
excitement, 
Yukino Bijin's childhood friend stood a 
step back, 
watching them in silence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Jingle...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, ever since the 
Puller's Bell came up, 
Yukino Bijin's childhood friend had looked 
like she 
wanted to say something. Could it be...?
choice_data_list: ...Excuse me, do you have a second?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: ...! Yes, what is it?
choice_data_list:
Is there something you want to give 
Yukino?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
—! 
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
...There is. 
Something from me—and from all of us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Day two of our stay in Iwate.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Kyaaah! Big Sis, you look so cute~~!

text_block_list.name: Super Muscular Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Dress up somethin' cute in cute clothes, 
and it's perfection! Fine feathers make 
fine fillies, right~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was the costume fitting for the 
village's Oobiki Mikoshi. 
Yesterday's "Big Sis" was decked out 
in a dazzling, radiant outfit.

text_block_list.name: Villager B
text_block_list.text:
Here now, attach this year's bell to that 
costume of yours. 
—Prayin' for your safety and good health. 
We all want nothin' more than to watch ya 
keep thrivin' and growin'.

text_block_list.name: Super Muscular Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Thank you. 
Heheh... I'm still in my growth spurt, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes'm! What is it?
choice_data_list:
Would you be surprised if I told you 
there's a costume and bell for you too?

Would you be surprised if I said there's a 
costume and bell for you too?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
—Yuki-chan! 
Here, this is your bell!! Please take it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wha-whaaat?! Mifuyu-chan, 
this bell you just handed me...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
It's a Puller's Bell. It's handmade, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I put so many heartfelt wishes into making 
it. 
Praying that you'll conquer that hill safe 
and sound, Yuki-chan.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mifuyu-chan...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
And that's not all! 
We heard that you became a Shinkoma, 
so everyone in the village got together to 
make you an outfit too!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Come on, Yuki-chan! Over this way!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...What an adorable outfit.

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fellow Villagers
text_block_list.text:
“Whoa...!” “It suits you so well, 
Yuki-chan!” 
“Cute as always~” “How's the big city 
treatin' ya?”

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Everyone came all the way out here too?! 
Not just the outfit, but goin' through all 
the trouble...

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Villager A
text_block_list.text:
Because we know just how hard you've been 
working, Yukino-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Villager B
text_block_list.text:
If it's for your sake, Yukino-chan, 
we'd rush over from anywhere, anytime!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of us 
just wants to cheer you on with all our 
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
That's why so many of our wishes 
—are packed right into that bell and 
costume!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ————! ...Mifuyu-chan, everyone...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Yuki-chan. Please keep running in your 
races. 
...And stay healthy, always and forever.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
You'll always, always be our pride and 
joy, Yuki-chan. 
We believe you can do anything.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: —Yuki-chan! Keep giving it your all!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
~~~~gh!! 
Yukino Bijin's gonna give it everything 
she's got, by golly!!

text_block_list.name: Super Muscular Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Yukino?! That thing over there is—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Nnngh, ngh, ngh~~~...! Hwaaaaa~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't push yourself too hard, Yukino! 
Yesterday, none of us could budge Big 
Sis's mikoshi— 
not even you...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, I gotta pull it! 
I gotta pull it right here, right now!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
With everyone watchin' me right now! 
I wanna show 'em... 
that their cheers make me stronger!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I gotta prove that everyone's prayers 
are what keep me moving forward!!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Yuki-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fellow Villagers
text_block_list.text:
“...You can do it!” “Don't give up!” 
“Hang in there!” “We believe in you, 
Yuki-chan!”

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ghhhrrr~~~! Urrrgh~~~...!!

text_block_list.name: Super Muscular Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: —Lock your elbows! Drop your hips lower!

text_block_list.name: Super Muscular Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
You wanna give your village a haul to be 
proud of, don'tcha?! 
Breathe out! Tuck your elbows in, and take 
a deep—inhale!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —!! YES, MA'AAAM!!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu & Villagers
text_block_list.text:
"Nnngh... Go get 'em, Yuki-chan!" 
"Yukino-chan can pull it!" "Go for it--!"

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
If it's Yuki-chan, she can do anythin' in 
the whole wide world!!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yaaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Woooooaaaaahhhhh--!)

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...To grow stronger. To grow faster. 
To grow wiser. To gain the power to answer 
another's call.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Each horsegirl's wish is as distinct and 
varied 
as the stars themselves. Yet, no matter 
the dream--

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
--the prayers of people push the 
horsegirls forward, 
and those who gaze upon their backs offer 
up their prayers once more.
